question.text: LTCG on listed equity (post July 2024) is taxed at:

answer.text: 12.5% on LTCG above Rs. 1.25 lakh per year

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Post-July 2024, 12.5% LTCG on equity over Rs. 1.25 lakh annually. **The Trap:** Older 10% rate no longer applies. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in XIX-A, XIX-B. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Time exits to distribute capital gains across years, using Rs. 1.25 lakh exemption.
